content:
maya: FYI escalated customer (ticket #7891) — calls to /v1/invoke are failing with 422 schema errors after SDK v2.3.0 rollout. Error mentions additionalProperties 'session_debug' and missing required 'api_key'. They started seeing this in prod ~08:12 UTC. Repro steps below.

sam: can you paste the exact failing payload + error body?

maya: here's the payload they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice-generator",
  "args": {
    "amount": "10000",            // sent as string, schema expects number
    "currency": "USD",
    "line_items": [{ "desc": "svc", "qty": 1 }],
    "session_debug": true,            // unexpected additionalProperty
    "billing_profile": null         // previously optional, now causing mismatch in strict schema
  },
  "callback_url": "https://client.example/cb"
}
```

maya: error returned from gateway: 
```
{
  "error": "schema_validation_failed",
  "status": 422,
  "details": [
    {"path": "args.api_key", "message": "is a required property"},
    {"path": "args.amount", "message": "expected number but got string"},
    {"path": "args.session_debug", "message": "additionalProperties not allowed"}
  ]
}
```

ivan: looks like two issues tangled: 1) auth not sent -> missing api_key required by our function-schema for that tool, 2) SDK started injecting debug/session fields and also coerces amount to string in some codepaths.

sophie: customer said they upgraded SDK from 2.2.x -> 2.3.0. I quickly grepped the changelog — there is a patch that adds `session.debug` and `billing_profile` plumbing for analytics. We probably tightened the function JSON schema in the gateway recently which now rejects additionalProperties.

sam: repro on our side: ran curl with their payload and got same 422. Curl used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"invoice-generator","args":{"amount":"10000","currency":"USD","session_debug":true}}'
```

dev-support-bot: [deploy/ingress-gateway] recent change 2026-03-09 03:14 UTC updated strict_schema=true for /v1/invoke routing to function-schemas.

ivan: minimal mitigation options: 
- temporary: allow additionalProperties for args in the affected tool schema (quick gateway config flip).
- short-term: coerce `amount` string -> number in token parsing layer (risky).
- long-term: bump SDK and gateway contract: add backward-compatible opt-in flag for strict schemas and update SDK to stop adding session_debug unless explicit.

maya: customer is on Dedicated and needs a quick fix. I'm going to flip the gateway schema leniency for the invoice-generator tool for now and ask them to downgrade to SDK 2.2.x as a safe workaround. I'll also ask them to include api_key in args (they were relying on header-to-args shim we removed).

sam: please add a short repro test in support harness to catch amount-as-string + extra props. Also open an escalation to eng-platform to review the strict_schema rollout.

maya: opening ENG ticket now: ENG-10234. Will include payloads + gateway logs.

ivan: note for the patch: when allowing additionalProperties temporarily, add an allowlist for `session_debug` and `billing_profile` so we don't open up unlimited fields. Also log a metric for how often this happens so product can decide schema policy.

sophie: I'll coordinate with SDK team to ship a 2.3.1 that stops injecting session_debug by default and ensures numeric fields remain numbers. ETA: 48h.

maya: customer notified of workaround (downgrade or wait ~30 min while we flip gateway). I'll confirm when gateway change live.

dev-support-bot: [config-change] ingress-gateway: lenient_schema(invoice-generator) = true (applied) — change id cfg-7782

maya: confirmed with customer after flip — calls now pass. Closing the loop; will follow up after SDK patch lands. :white_check_mark:

sam: follow-up items: add unit test for schema coercion, annotate rollback plan if leniency causes any issues, and add a note in the release notes about schema strictness.

maya: Thanks team. I'll attach the ENG ticket and paste postmortem once done.
